heading: Add a visual signature stamp
catalog_description: Add a typed visual signature mark. It does not verify identity or create a certified or cryptographic signature.
seo_title: Add a Visual Signature Stamp to a PDF | Paperplane
seo_how_to: Upload the PDF and enter the printed name to show
Run Signature Stamp to add the visual mark
Download and review the marked PDF; the stamp is not identity verification
seo_faqs: Does this stamp verify who signed the document?
No. It adds a visual mark only; it does not verify identity, create a cryptographic signature, or provide a certified e-signature workflow.
Does Paperplane provide a certificate authority?
No. A visual stamp is not certificate-backed signing. Any cryptographic signature must be independently validated against a certificate chain trusted by its recipient.
Can I verify a signed PDF after downloading it?
Yes. Use the verification workflow to inspect signature status, byte ranges, and integrity information supported by the document.
Does Paperplane keep a job history?
No. This version does not provide a recent-files or job-history page. Download the result when processing finishes; temporary server job files are removed by the retention cleanup.
